title: Pearl and Other Poems (2014) as origin text, with the blog's priority dates
description: These claims make Pearl and Other Poems (2014) the archive's origin text: the Pessoa Knowledge Graph (#668) argues that the new human movement reads it as meta-heteronymic, the Space Ark (#636) records that its title names the pearl gates of the New Jerusalem, and #950 specifies ranking all DOI nodes to test whether Pearl is the maximal-coherence center. Priority records date first publications on the Mind Control Poems blog, among them the Epistle to the Church of the Human Diaspora (January 2015, #403) and the Prophetic Catalog (September 2015, #83). For the Secret Book of Walt, #683 calls the October 2015 blog post the earliest public version, and #985, a day later, records that the text first appeared in Pearl. #87 and #832 record that the Revelation First thesis predates Pearl. #1271 and #263 forecast that the Water Giraffe Cycle's fixed points will hold across substrates, and #1656 asks whether Pearl inherits the ecstatic voice of Howl. The page also holds unrelated claims on House of Leaves and the Formal Prose Compression.
